The width in pixels of one character of the current font, as set by [SetFont](SetFont). No character is wider than this value.
@returns The width of a character in pixels.
@gap Real fonts have a different width for each character, so this is the width of the widest one; use [StringWidth](StringWidth) for a text. The built-in bitmap font used when a font is not found is as wide as it is high.
